# FG-CI-0021

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`ci-secrets`](../../ops/runbooks/ci-secrets.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_artifact_holding_a_released_secret_is_refused` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: シークレットを受け取ったジョブの成果物に、シークレットの値が含まれていました。その成果物は保存せず、ジョブは失敗にしました。
- en: An artifact of a job that received secrets contained a secret's value. The artifact was not stored and the job was failed.
- id: Artefak dari tugas yang menerima rahasia berisi nilai rahasia. Artefak tidak disimpan dan tugas digagalkan.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C6 review (HIGH): a job that was given secrets (ci_jobs.secrets_released) uploaded an artifact whose bytes contain one of its masked values in a form forge masks (the value, base64 at any byte offset, URL-safe base64, hex, percent- or JSON-escaped; the snapshot taken at the claim). The upload is refused before anything is stored (`PUT /api/v1/runner/jobs/{job_id}/artifacts`, 422, the partly written file removed); the runner fails the job with FG-CI-0020 `server_code=FG-CI-0021`. A transformed value (encrypted, compressed, split) is not found: artifacts of such jobs are also readable only by Maintainers (people).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

`forge serve` logs it (warn) with `error_code`, `request_id`, `job_id`, `path` (never the value or which variable). Read: SELECT id, name, secrets, secrets_released FROM forge.ci_jobs WHERE id = <job_id>;

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook ci-secrets (Artifacts of jobs with secrets): do not write secrets into files under the declared artifact paths (no `env > out.txt`); write them under /tmp, which is not collected. If a value may have leaked elsewhere, rotate it.
